title: Avatar
synopsis: Pandora. Floating mountains, glowing forests, a tree as old as your grandmother. You're a marine in a Na'vi body. You're supposed to be spying. You're starting to fall in love.

nodes.text: Your brother is dead. You are in his body's contract.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Take the job” back. Brother shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.

nodes.text: Mining base, mechs, AMP suits. Selfridge wants ore.

choices.consequence: “Listen to Selfridge” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Job.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Science.

nodes.text: You wake in a Na'vi body. You run on grass.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Joy.
“Stand still” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.

nodes.text: Things glow. Things growl. Then a creature attacks.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Climb” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.

nodes.text: She saves you. She is, briefly, angry.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Listen.” The story records the instinct as “Humble” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Apologize fast” back. Civil shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Branches the size of streets. Eytukan. Mo'at.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Be respectful.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.
“Ask many questions” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Curious.

nodes.text: Neytiri teaches. You ride a banshee. You make a bond.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Trust the bond.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
“Hesitate” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Quaritch wants intel on the tree. He wants a way in.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Stall” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Job.

nodes.text: You see the tree of voices. The wind speaks ancestors.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You take a mate. Neytiri chooses you.

choices.consequence: “Choose her back” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Heart.
You commit to “Stay torn.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Earthmovers tear up sacred ground.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Vow.
There is no taking “Report it” back. Process shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Quaritch shows your video log. The Na'vi see you for the spy you were.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Confess” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: The tree, ancient, comes down.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Save.
There is no taking “Fight back now” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Neytiri turns away. Eytukan dies. You stand in the smoke.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
You commit to “Mourn.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You climb. You bond with the biggest banshee. You return as legend.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Strategy.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Humble.

nodes.text: You ride to all the clans. They come.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Path—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Follow Neytiri.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Sky people, missiles, mechs. Animals you didn't know about charge.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Trust Eywa.” The story records the instinct as “Faith” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brain—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Mech vs. avatar. Neytiri saves you.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Vow.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Vow.

nodes.text: Your human body is starving in the chamber. You have minutes.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Make the transfer” back. Path shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Wait.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Mo'at and the tribe gather. You pass through the eye of Eywa.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: New.

choices.text: Hold on to the old self
choices.consequence: There is no taking “Hold on to the old self” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You wake as Na'vi for good. Neytiri's hand finds yours.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Path—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Build the bridge to humans.” The story records the instinct as “Hope” and carries it forward.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You and Neytiri lead a generation. You hold the sky people back. You teach your children both languages. They prefer the older one.
You broker, slowly, a peace between Pandora and a chastened RDA. The mining shrinks. The science stays. Grace, before she died, would have laughed.
Eventually you die. Your consciousness joins the network of the tree. Children, walking the forest, hear your voice in the wind. They take it for granted, the way you would have, once.
